**Lifecycle/exclusions checked:** `disengage` calls `releaseJoints`, removes live primary/helper joints and their run-hand state, clears both primary actor engagement pointers, clears matching helper pointers, and removes the rep. Old joint objects need not have their actor fields nulled once absent from World. Reachable full-extension steering and acquired tensile cloth holds remain supported by opposing controls. Any rep with `helpers.length > 0` retains the old grace: this preserves useful helper work but does not solve primary validity inside combinations. Active pass reps retain their old separation and post-throw behavior. The pre-existing pass→run conversion happens before this check, so a converted solo rep uses the new run cutoff; “pass excluded” should be read with that qualification.

**Timing limit:** a 20Hz lifecycle boundary, not a continuous contact-law guarantee. The release is before joint sync/hand-fight update and the next World solve. A contact starting inside the bound can still transmit after crossing it within that50ms tick; an excursion returning inside before the next boundary can be missed. Behavior decisions also precede this cleanup. No exact substep release or immediate new free-player decision is established by this patch.
